headline: Approved disbursements of $417,842.76 for July 2026 and $395,045.77 for August 2026.
summary: The board approved the minutes of its August 28, 2026 meeting. It also approved two disbursements of funds: $417,842.76 for July 2026 and $395,045.77 for August 2026. A trustee reported on IRS questions about proposed ordinance changes, but no vote was taken.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 28, 2026 meeting, unanimously by members present.
Approved disbursement of $417,842.76 for July 1, 2026 through July 31, 2026, unanimously by members present.
Approved disbursement of $395,045.77 for August 1, 2026 through August 30, 2026, unanimously by members present.

Page 1 of 2  
 
  
BOARD OF TRUSTEES 
Division of Public Works Retirement System 
Meeting Minutes 
September 25, 2026 
 
 
A meeting of the Board of Trustees, Public Wo rks Retirement System was held at 10:32 a.m. 
on Friday, September 25, 2026 in The Mine Falls Conference Room located at 848 West Hollis 
Street, Nashua, NH 03062.   
 
 
Trustees Present: 
 
David Fredette, Finance & Investment Professional (Chairman) 
Daniel Hudson, Unaffiliated Employee Member  
Matt Dube, AFSME Employee Member 
Terri Harris, UAW Employee Member 
Diane Mulholland, Treasurer/Tax Collector, Member 
Michael O’Brien, Aldermanic Liaison (Assistant Chair)  
 
 
Trustees Absent: 
 
Manny Espitia, BPW Commissioner 
 
 
Others in Attendance: 
 
 Carolyn O’Connor, Assistant Director of PW Finance & Admin 
 Joanne Boisvert, Trust Accountant 
 Mary Woods, Administrative Assistant 
 
 
Expected Visitors: 
 
None 
 
 
Minutes of the Meeting: 
 
The minutes of the August 28, 2026 meeting were presented for review and acceptance.  
 
MOTION BY:  Alderman Michael O’Brien moved to approve the minutes of the August 28, 
2026 meeting as reviewed and presented. 
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Diane Mulholland 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:   
 
 
Personnel: 
 
 None
Page 2 of 2  
 
Old Business: 
 
 Trustee Fredette also reported that regarding the update for IRS ordinance changes, he has 
distributed a letter from the IRS in response to Attorney Rich’s proposed ordinance changes 
on this board’s behalf.  He stated that there are a lot of questions from the IRS.  Attorney 
Rich has prepared a packet for an extension and Trustee Fredette has signed the two forms 
required and believe it was being sent back to the IRS today, 9/25/26.  Attorney Rich stated 
that he doesn’t see anything that concerns him in the letter. 
 
 
New Business:  
 
A. MOTION BY:   Alderman, Michael O’Brien moved to approve the disbursement of funds for 
the period of July 1, 2026 through July 31, 2026 in the amount of $417,842.76. 
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Terri Harris 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:   
 
B. MOTION BY:   Trustee, Diane Mulholland moved to approve the disbursement of funds for 
the period of August 1, 2026 through August 30, 2026 in the amount of $395,045.77. 
SECONDED BY:  Alderman, Michael O’Brien 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:   
 
 
 
Period for Public Comment: 
 
None 
 
 
Items by the Trustees: 
  
None   
 
 
 
 
Next meeting will be scheduled for Friday, October 30, 2026, at 10:30 a.m.  
 
MOTION TO ADJOURN:  Trustee, Diane Mulholland moved to adjourn at 10:40 a.m. 
SECONDED BY: Trustee, Terri Harris 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION: 
 
Minutes Transcribed by:  Mary Woods
